<thought>Based on the molecular formula C5H11O3Br and DBE = 0, the compound must be a saturated acyclic molecule containing a bromine atom, three oxygens (as alcohols/ethers), and five carbons. A structure that satisfies these constraints is Br‑CH₂‑CH(OH)‑CH₂‑O‑CH₂‑CH₂‑OH, which corresponds to the SMILES string “BrCC(O)COCCO”.</thought>
<final_answer>BrCC(O)COCCO</final_answer>
